```{r}

# install.packages(c("quantmod", "forecast"))
library(quantmod)
library(forecast)

# 1. Input data
ko <- getSymbols("KO", src = "yahoo", from = "2023-01-01", to = "2024-12-31", auto.assign = FALSE)
y  <- as.numeric(Ad(ko))

# 2. Split 70% train / 30% test
n     <- floor(0.7 * length(y))
train <- y[1:n]
test  <- y[(n + 1):length(y)]

# 3. Fit SES and forecast the test period
fit <- ses(train, h = length(test))
fit$model$par["alpha"]   # optimal alpha
accuracy(fit, test)      # MAE, RMSE, MAPE

# 4. Plot
plot(fit, main = "SES on KO (70% train / 30% test)")
lines((n + 1):length(y), test, col = "red")
legend("topleft", c("Train", "SES forecast", "Actual test"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")


```
```{r}
library(quantmod)
library(forecast)

# Data
ko <- getSymbols("KO", src = "yahoo", from = "2023-01-01", to = "2024-12-31", auto.assign = FALSE)
y  <- as.numeric(Ad(ko))

# 70 / 30 split
n     <- floor(0.7 * length(y))
train <- y[1:n]
test  <- y[(n + 1):length(y)]

# SES
fit     <- ses(train, h = length(test))
refit   <- ets(y, model = fit$model)
onestep <- fitted(refit)[(n + 1):length(y)]

# Plot (all in one go)
plot(fit, main = "SES on KO (70% train / 30% test)")
lines((n + 1):length(y), test,    col = "red")
lines((n + 1):length(y), onestep, col = "darkgreen")
legend("topleft", c("Train", "SES static forecast", "Actual test", "SES rolling 1-step"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red", "darkgreen"), lty = 1, bty = "n")

# Accuracy
fit$model$par["alpha"]
accuracy(fit, test)        # static
accuracy(onestep, test)    # rolling
```


```{r}
library(quantmod)
library(forecast)

run <- function(ticker, from, to, method, title) {
  d <- getSymbols(ticker, src = "yahoo", from = from, to = to, auto.assign = FALSE)
  y <- as.numeric(Ad(d))
  n <- floor(0.7 * length(y))
  train <- y[1:n]; test <- y[(n + 1):length(y)]

  fit <- if (method == "ses") ses(train, h = length(test)) else holt(train, h = length(test))

  plot(y, type = "l", ylim = range(y, fit$mean), xlab = "Day", ylab = "Price", main = title)
  lines((n + 1):length(y), test, col = "red")
  lines((n + 1):length(y), fit$mean, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
  abline(v = n, lty = 2, col = "gray")
  legend("topleft", c("Train", "Actual test", "Forecast"),
         col = c("black", "red", "blue"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
}

par(mfrow = c(3, 1))
run("KO",   "2023-01-01", "2024-12-31", "ses",  "Straight: SES on KO")
run("NVDA", "2023-01-01", "2024-06-30", "holt", "Up: Holt on NVDA")
run("INTC", "2022-01-01", "2022-12-31", "holt", "Down: Holt on INTC")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
```{r}
library(quantmod)
library(forecast)

ko <- getSymbols("KO", src = "yahoo", from = "2023-01-01", to = "2024-12-31", auto.assign = FALSE)
y  <- as.numeric(Ad(ko))

n     <- floor(0.7 * length(y))
train <- y[1:n]
test  <- y[(n + 1):length(y)]
fit   <- ses(train, h = length(test))

# Zoom settings: change these to zoom more or less
before <- 30            # days of training to show before the forecast
after  <- 40            # days of forecast to show
x1 <- n - before
x2 <- n + after

plot(fit, xlim = c(x1, x2),
     ylim = range(y[x1:x2], fit$lower[1:after, ], fit$upper[1:after, ]),
     main = "SES on KO (zoomed)", xlab = "Day", ylab = "Price")
lines((n + 1):x2, test[1:after], col = "red", lwd = 2)
abline(v = n, lty = 2, col = "gray")
legend("topleft", c("Train", "SES forecast", "Actual test"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
```
```{r}
lvl   <- fit$mean[1]     # the SES forecast value (same for every day)
after <- 5               # how many forecast days to show
x1    <- n - 10
x2    <- n + after

plot(x1:n, y[x1:n], type = "o", pch = 19, cex = 0.6,
     xlim = c(x1, x2), ylim = range(y[x1:x2], lvl),
     xlab = "Day", ylab = "Price", main = "SES: does the next day hit the line?")

# Blue straight forecast line, starting from the end of training
segments(n, lvl, x2, lvl, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# Red actual prices, connected to the last training point
lines(n:x2, y[n:x2], col = "red", lwd = 2, type = "o", pch = 19)

# Show the miss (error) for each forecast day as a dotted line
segments((n + 1):x2, lvl, (n + 1):x2, test[1:after], lty = 3)

abline(v = n, lty = 2, col = "gray")
legend("topleft", c("Train", "SES forecast", "Actual"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")

# Numbers: how close is each day to the line?
data.frame(day      = 1:after,
           forecast = round(lvl, 3),
           actual   = round(test[1:after], 3),
           error    = round(test[1:after] - lvl, 3))
```
